responsibilities: Read creative brief and extract artifact type, audience, objective, narrative, visual language

Run the ls-artifact-qa gate before delivery

steps: 1. User provides a creative brief or prompt
2. Creative Director loads ls-design-system and the Open Design brand system
3. Creative Director asks 5 intake questions (artifact type, audience, objective, narrative, visual language)
4. Creative Director routes to the appropriate production skill
5. Production skill creates the artifact through Open Design with brand constraints
6. Creative Director runs ls-artifact-qa (visual, brand, UX, accessibility, content)

open-design-integration.description: How a production skill drives the Open Design render layer
steps: 2. Choose the Open Design project and design system
3. Build a design prompt with brand constraints
5. Export the artifact in the required format
